note: Both sets extract many correct claims but suffer from significant duplication and identical hallucinations. Both sets incorrectly state the mechanical force as 20,000 PSI (the text says 25,000 PSI), fabricate a quote regarding hysteresis ('to return to full martensite'), and miss the 90C transition temperature for commercially available wire. Set A incorrectly claims 'roughly 55 percent Titanium', while Set B incorrectly claims 'roughly 50 percent Nickel'. Because they share the same major flaws and have a similar number of errors, they are of equal quality.
